sentences.en: The first calculating tool of mankind is called an abacus.
sentences.zh: 人类最早使用的计算工具被称为算盘。

sentences.en: Computers can be thought of as mere calculating machines.
sentences.zh: 计算机可以被视为简单的计算机器。

sentences.en: Primitive calculating machines existed long before computers were developed.
sentences.zh: 在计算机发明之前很久，就已经存在原始的计算机器了。

senses.zh: 计算的；深谋远虑的；审慎的
